Cc: procurement@orionanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Master Agreement kickoff + order-form packet — Orion Analytics

Hi team,

Looping everyone in to start the contracting intake for Orion Analytics. They signed the commercial terms in the PO and are ready to move to legal redlines. High level: customer wants Redwood-hosted inference for analytics pipelines (multi-tenant), US data residency, and standard retention. They also listed a few SKUs and projected monthly tokens — attached is the draft order form they filled out.

Asks:
- Legal: can you review the attached order-form draft and the party/billing sheet and advise if we need to swap to the dedicated capacity language or add an SLA carveout?
- Security: they attached a short security attestation (they say SOC2 Type II is available). Kimberly — can you confirm evidence request and timeline?
- Sales/Ops: Marissa, please confirm billing entity and who will sign from their side (I asked below).

Attachments: Orion_OrderForm_Draft_20260804.xlsx (spreadsheet with SKUs & volumes)

Timeline: Customer would prefer 5–10 business-day turnaround on first redline. If legal needs more time, flag now.

Thanks — I’ll add the HubSpot deal link to the thread.

—
Jonas Weber

jonas@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@orionanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Master Agreement kickoff + order-form packet — Orion Analytics

Thanks Jonas — received and starting intake. A few quick clarifications before we open a redline file: 

1) Hosting model: you mention "Redwood-hosted, multi-tenant" — is there any requirement for a single-tenant or dedicated cluster for specific workloads? That will drive an SLA/hosting exhibit.
2) Data residency: "US" is broad — do they require specific region (us-west-2) or any US region is acceptable?
3) Billing entity & tax details: we need the legal name used on the PO and a W-9 or equivalent for US billing.
4) Security evidence: Tara, can you confirm whether Orion can share SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) or a SOC 2 attestation letter. If not, confirm the list of controls they can provide (encryption at rest, access controls, incident response).

I attached our contract intake template to capture party-sheet, signatory authority, and hosting options. Please populate and return — that will speed routing.

I will tentatively schedule a 30-min intake sync for next Tuesday morning if that works for their procurement team.

Attachments: RI_ContractIntake_Template_v3.docx

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
kimberly@redwood.com

[Attachment: RI_ContractIntake_Template_v3.docx]

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few answers inline:

- Hosting: Multi-tenant is acceptable. We do not require a dedicated cluster.
- Data residency: US-only is fine; prefer us-west-2 but willing to accept any US region if it reduces lead time.
- Billing entity: Orion Analytics, Inc. (EIN: 27-1234567) — PO will reference this name. Procurement contact is procurement@orionanalytics.com (CC’d).
- Security: We can share a SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short security attestation PDF (attached).
- Signatory: I am the authorized signatory for commercial agreements up to $500k. I attached a signed letter of authority and a redacted W-9 for your records.

Attachments included: Orion_Signer_Authority.pdf, Orion_Security_Attestation.pdf

We need an initial redline within ~5 business days if possible (internal procurement wants to finalize by Aug 16). Let us know if that timeline is doable.

Best,
Tara
